updates.rationale: Program-level effort for coordinating the code-structure converse, reconciling analytic and computational components, and integrating rigorous finite-block and asymptotic conclusions.

Independent discovery requires formulating and proving the finite-block dependence balance, controlling vanishing decoding defects, preserving the coordinate encoder, and investigating channel-specific refinements beyond coarse entropy constraints.

Exploratory effort is needed to construct and exactify a surviving entropic witness, implement verification, test copy extensions and information inequalities, and establish the resulting limitation of the converse relaxation.
